My initial inquiry was made on 15 May 2026. I submitted my loan application and uploaded all the required documents on 23 May 2026. Despite providing everything on time, my case was logged only on 1 June 2026. I was assured that the sanction letter would be issued shortly thereafter.

However, as of 6 June 2026, I have still not received any update regarding my application or the expected timeline for the sanction letter.

The biggest concern is the complete lack of communication and accountability. Initially, Abhishek Pathak was assigned to handle my case, but I was later informed that he had left the organization. I was then directed to contact Dileep Vishwakarma, but despite multiple attempts, I have received no response from him either.

No one is taking ownership of the case, and there is no clear point of contact. Customers are left chasing updates without any support, transparency, or timely communication.

I expected a professional and customer-focused service, but unfortunately my experience has been the opposite. I request the management team to improve communication, accountability, and customer service standards so that other customers do not face similar issues.

Application ID: B00XMOX

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Axis Bank #Axisbank#parelbranch
"Extremely poor and unprofessional service at the Parel branch. I visited the branch at 11:00 AM for a Pay Order of 1.5 Lakhs. Despite reaching early, I was simply told to sit and wait without any clear communication.
​I kept following up every few minutes, but for over an hour and 15 minutes, the staff repeatedly gave the same excuse that they were 'verifying' it. Even after escalating the matter to the Branch Manager, there was no sense of urgency. I was made to sit there for 2 full hours for a task that shouldn't take that long. They finally handed over the Pay Order just one minute before their lunch break started.
​This branch has no respect for the customer's time. Very disappointed with the slow processing and lack of accountability from the management. Avoid this branch if you value your time."
​

Also there was no response from bank manager, relationship manager or the general customer care emails. Highly disappointed.

0 stars should be an option here.
